class.name: LRTGeometryBinding3D
class.brief_description: Binds a mesh instance to its own object-space Color SDF resource.
class.description: Place this node directly under a [MeshInstance3D]. The parent mesh and its effective materials define the bake; the binding's own transform is ignored. The parent must use Dynamic GI mode to contribute through its Color SDF. Different material instances require separate baked resources. Select this node and use [b]Bake LRT Color SDF[/b] in the 3D toolbar, or call [method bake]. The bake includes two sample cells of padding and uses native Forward+ GPU material evaluation for opaque [StandardMaterial3D], [ORMMaterial3D] and spatial [ShaderMaterial] passes. UV/UV2, custom vertex attributes, original VERTEX_ID, material and instance uniforms, global uniforms, vertex/fragment shader code, material overrides, opaque next passes and overlays use the engine's material implementation, not a CPU feature whitelist. The resulting linear diffuse color (including metallic reduction), unexposed emission and vertex positions feed the geometry cache. A separate triangle atlas preserves the mesh's original UV2. Its texel density is four texels per geometry sample cell; oversized atlases fail explicitly. Dynamic Color SDF geometry must remain a closed, consistently oriented triangle manifold after vertex evaluation. Open/non-manifold and skeletal/blend-shape deformation fail without replacing the previous bake. When LRT is enabled, this binding registers its parent Dynamic GI instance with the CPU geometry scheduler. Each volume in the same [World3D] collects intersecting bindings and rebuilds affected trunks when the parent moves, changes GI mode or visibility, or the baked resource changes. Removing the binding removes its contribution. Its own transform is ignored at runtime as well as during baking. [b]Development status:[/b] CPU geometry composition, GPU upload/history reset, direct-light/shadow and sky injection, A/L propagation and Forward+ direct Probe surface sampling are available. Disable rendering/lrt/screen_gather_enabled to select this rendering path. Screen Gather, guided upsampling and priority-ordered nested-volume boundary inputs are available. Color SDF diagnostics support the zero isosurface and axis-aligned distance/color slices through Display Advanced and Inspect LRT. Transparent, alpha-cutout, discarded, refractive and screen-reading passes are receivers only and do not contribute reflection or occlusion. A fully transparent instance bake records a receiver-only resource; the runtime excludes that binding from geometry scheduling. Transparent materials receive LRT through the direct sampling path.

method.name: configure_debug
method.description: Selects this instance for LRT Color SDF viewport diagnostics. slice_axis is -1 for the zero isosurface or 0/1/2 for an X/Y/Z sample slice. Negative distance shows material color, positive distance is blue and the zero contour is white. Does not modify the baked resource or scene lighting.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes the parent instance in object space and saves the result to a binary [code].res[/code] resource. Assigns [member bake_data] only after a successful save. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_SKIP] when canceled, or an error code. LRT builds the engine triangle BVH without vertex snapping and uses double-precision triangle predicates to retain thin imported faces. The binding transform does not affect the bake. World transforms, uniforms, shader time and the active viewport camera (or the identity bake view when absent) define a frozen material/vertex snapshot. These inputs are not reevaluated as the instance moves. Changing them requires rebaking.

method.name: get_geometry_instance
method.description: Returns the parent mesh instance, or null when this binding is not a direct child of a MeshInstance3D.

members.member: Object-space geometry cache for this instance. Mesh or material edits require rebaking. Moving the instance preserves the baked colors, including world-triplanar colors; rebake if those colors need to reflect the new world position.
Sample count along the longest Color SDF axis. Other axes are proportional. Includes two cells of padding at each end; must be at least 6.
